preconditions.description: The input is a single positive integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10¹⁸) represented as a string of digits with no leading zeros.

postconditions.description: If the input n is a hill number, the output is the count of all hill numbers ≤ n. A hill number is defined as a positive integer whose digits first non-decrease and then non-increase (possibly with a single peak or plateau).
If the input n is not a hill number, the output is -1.
